test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Given below is a statement followed by two possible reasons numbered I and II. Read the statement carefully and decide which of the two explain(s) the event/observation/information given in the statement.

Statement - The movement of a person or people from one country, locality, place of residence to settle in another country, locality, place of residence is known as migration.

Reasons:

I. Some person or people migrate in search of work or economic opportunities, to join family, or to study. Others migrate to escape conflict, persecution, terrorism, or human rights violations.

II. Some person or people migrate in response to the adverse effects of climate change, natural disasters, or other environmental factors.

options.text: Both I and II are possible reasons
Neither I nor II is a possible reason.
Only I is a possible reason.
Only II is a possible reason.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II are possible reasons**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Migration** refers to the movement of a person or people from one country, locality, or place of residence to settle in another.
 
• **Reason I** explains that migration occurs due to various factors such as the search for work, economic opportunities, joining family, or studying. Additionally, people may migrate to escape conflict, persecution, terrorism, or human rights violations.
 
• **Reason II** highlights that migration can also be driven by environmental factors such as the adverse effects of climate change, natural disasters, or other environmental challenges.
 
• Both reasons are valid and encompass a wide range of factors that contribute to migration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Reason I**__

 __
 
• People often migrate for **economic opportunities** such as better job prospects and higher wages.
 
• **Family reunification** is another important factor where people move to join family members already settled in another region.
 
• Many students migrate to pursue **higher education** and enhance their skills.
 
• Migration also occurs as a means to escape **conflict, persecution, or human rights violations**, ensuring personal safety and security.
 
 
 
• **Reason II**__
 
 
• Climate change has led to **environmental degradation**, prompting people to move to safer areas.
 
• **Natural disasters** such as earthquakes, floods, and hurricanes can cause significant displacement.
 
• Other environmental factors like **desertification** and **rising sea levels** also contribute to migration.
